acs.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 2024 1-year PUMS (person file, US)
acs.ethnicity_rule: hispanic if HISP!=01; else middle_eastern if ANC1P/ANC2P in mena_ancestry_codes; else RAC1P 1 white, 2 black, 6 asian, 9 mixed; else other
acs.single_rule: MAR 2 widowed, 3 divorced, 5 never married = single; 1 married, 4 separated = not single
acs.income_rule: PINCP * ADJINC / 1e6, bucket = highest INCOME_STEPS value <= income; <=0 -> bucket 0
acs.kids_rule: own never-married children under 18 living in the same household (householder + spouse/partner via RELSHIPP 25/26/27; subfamily parents via SFN/SFR); capped at 4
acs.universe: all persons 18+, household and group-quarters population

nhanes.source: CDC/NCHS, National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey, Aug 2021–Aug 2023

checks.check: State table: 50 states + DC, none empty
Cube ages 18..90, top-coded ages pooled as 90+
Cube income steps = INCOME_STEPS in index.html
Every ethnicity chip has a cube group
checks.ours: asian, black, hispanic, middle_eastern, mixed, white
checks.expected: asian, black, hispanic, middle_eastern, mixed, white

local.source: U.S. Census Bureau, ACS 2020–2024 5-year PUMS (person files by state)
local.crosswalk: 2020 tract→PUMA relationship file + 2020 Census tract populations + OMB July 2023 CBSA delineation (2020 for Connecticut); a PUMA is in an area when most of its people are
